verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring scans is a fair axis for a security-scanning platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Snyk-native recurring schedule, cron, or periodic job feature. It only shows one-off CLI runs (`snyk test`, `snyk code test`, `snyk fix --agentic`), on-demand agent prompts, and running the CLI inside a user's CI/CD pipeline. CI/CD scheduling belongs to the host platform and earns no credit, and `snyk monitor` appears only by name, with no stated recurring behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
